svg.text: Grm7 abundance in each of the twelve mice
BAM-derived corrected CB/UB support · mice are biological replicates · counts are descriptive
Blue: six WT mice · rust: six cKO mice. Raw counts printed below each animal. Cell numbers and library sizes differ; these are not DESeq2 effects.
Original Cell Ranger gene counts are preserved separately in original_matrix_vs_BAM_gene_counts.tsv.
